recent_game.fact: Temple lost 49-48 in overtime at Toledo after an attempted game-winning two-point conversion fell incomplete.
Temple led Toledo 24-14 at halftime and 42-28 with 6:40 remaining, but Toledo scored twice in the final 1:05 to force overtime.
Temple rushed for 158 yards in the first half against Toledo and 270 yards for the game.
Kevin Hornbeak forced a fumble on Toledo's first offensive play, and Saboor Karriem recovered it.

quarterback.fact: Ajani Sheppard threw the first touchdown pass of his career against Toledo, a two-yard fourth-down completion to Joey Schlaffer.
Sheppard also threw a 69-yard touchdown pass to Colin Chase and scored on a 22-yard run in overtime against Toledo.
Jaxon Smolik started each of Temple's first three games at quarterback, while Sheppard appeared in all three.
Temple's quarterback room is led by transfers Smolik from Penn State and Sheppard from Washington State, with Camren Boykin, Brady Palmer and Lamar Best behind them.

offensive_personnel.fact: Rutgers transfer Sam Brown made his Temple debut against Toledo and rushed for a career-high 109 yards while scoring three combined touchdowns.
Temple returned four 2025 offensive-line starters: left tackle Giakoby Hills, left guard Eric King, center Grayson Mains and right guard Jackson Pruitt.
Rutgers transfer Zach Aamland entered the lineup because of injuries in the season opener and is listed as one of Temple's starting tackles.
Peter Clarke entered 2026 after recording 30 receptions and six touchdown catches in 2025.
Joey Schlaffer joined Temple's tight-end room after transferring from Penn State, while Patrick Keller moved from quarterback to tight end.

defensive_personnel.fact: Linebacker Curly Ordonez led Temple in tackles in each of the first three games of 2026 and recorded double-digit tackles in two of them.
Temple added five safeties during the January portal window: Saboor Karriem, Kolin Dinkins, Jaeden Gould, Orel Gray and Josiah Jackson.
Karriem started each of Temple's first three games at safety, while Eric Stuart, Curly Ordonez, Jaylon Joseph and Kevin Hornbeak also started all three games at their defensive positions.
Willy Love moved from safety to linebacker for the 2026 season, and Bryson Goodwin moved from wide receiver to the secondary.

coaching_changes.fact: Temple retained all three coordinators from 2025: offensive coordinator Tyler Walker, defensive coordinator Brian L. Smith and special-teams coordinator Brian Ginn.
Henry Baker was promoted to assistant head coach while continuing to coach Temple's cornerbacks.

injury_availability.fact: Cornerback Devontae Ward-Grant will miss the entire 2026 season after suffering an injury during the spring.
Luke Watson worked with the first-team offensive line during the spring and summer before an injury opened an opportunity for Kevin Terry at right tackle.
Sam Brown played his first game for Temple against Toledo after not appearing in the first two games.

offensive_context.fact: Temple rushed for 697 yards through its first three games and gained at least 186 rushing yards in each game.
Through three games, Temple averaged 221.3 rushing yards, 137.7 passing yards and 31.7 points per game.
Temple converted 41.0 percent of its third downs and scored on every red-zone possession through three games.

defensive_context.fact: Through three games, Temple allowed 414.7 total yards and 30.0 points per game.
Temple allowed 117.3 rushing yards and 297.3 passing yards per game through three contests.
Opponents converted 51.3 percent of their third downs against Temple through three games.
Defensive coordinator Brian L. Smith uses a multiple, NFL-style defense designed to present offenses with different looks.

special_teams.fact: Carl Hardin made field goals of 41 and 48 yards against Toledo.
Hardin returned as Temple's starting kicker after making 11 of 14 field goals and all 40 extra-point attempts in 2025.
Punter Dante Atton averaged 47.0 yards per punt in Temple's season-opening win over Rhode Island.
UNLV transfer Sam Wolfenden took over Temple's long-snapping duties in 2026.
